10k.note: Per FY2025 10-K, the company (formerly Synaptogenix, Inc.) launched a cryptocurrency-treasury strategy focused on the Bittensor TAO token in 2025 and renamed itself TAO Synergies. The Cleveland Clinic Bryostatin-1 Alzheimer's disease trial concluded by end of 2024; the Multiple Sclerosis Bryostatin-1 trial was discontinued. No active P1/P2/P3 trials remain.

website.note: Corporate identity has shifted to a digital-asset / AI-crypto treasury strategy; no active drug-pipeline page maintained.

ctgov.note: Legacy Synaptogenix-sponsored Bryostatin-1 trials are no longer active.
